source: Sky
target: 天空

source: &1460 So, despite the incident at Animus, I may have some good news.
target: &1460 虽说阿尼姆斯那边出了事，不过我这儿可能有个好消息。

source: &1010 We might have a break in that string of Mindjackings.
target: &1010 那一连串意识劫持案，可能有突破了。

source: &1374 Van der Waal agreed to talk?
target: &1374 范德瓦尔肯开口了？

source: &1011 I...uh...yeah. How'd you guess?
target: &1011 我……呃……对。你怎么猜到的？

source: &1375 He couldn't hold out forever.
target: &1375 他撑不了一辈子。

source: &1461 I managed to get Giel Van der Waal, the 'legitimate businessman', to cooperate.
target: &1461 我总算让吉尔·范德瓦尔这位“正经商人”肯配合了。

source: &1462 Says he has information on the Mindjacker.
target: &1462 他说有意识劫持者的线索。

source: &1376 What did he say?
target: &1376 他说了什么？

source: &1012 Didn't want to talk over the...
target: &1012 他不想通过……

source: &1013 Central wants a word.
target: &1013 中枢要跟我们谈谈。

source: &82 Dr Regis. Dr Lao.
target: &82 里吉斯博士。劳博士。

source: &1378 This isn't just a social call for an update, is it Central?
target: &1378 中枢，你不会只是来闲聊，问问进展吧？

source: &87 Dr Regis, lately you have spent a great deal of your time off-network.
target: &87 里吉斯博士，你最近有很长一段时间没有接入网络。

source: &88 It is for your safety, and that of the citizens that we...
target: &88 为了你以及市民的安全，我们……

source: &90 All points bulletin, evacuation in progress at Barber's Gate transit station.
target: &90 全体通报：巴伯门交通站正在疏散人员。

source: &91 Case Officers Regis and Lao assigned to crisis management.
target: &91 指派办案探员里吉斯与劳负责危机处置。

source: &1379 What's happening at the -
target: &1379 那边到底出了什么——

source: &92 All case data has been transferred to Dr Lao. Your vehicle has been rerouted.
target: &92 所有案件资料已传送给劳博士。车辆路线已重新规划。

source: &93 Please seek an expedient resolution to the situation. Central out.
target: &93 请尽快解决现场状况。中枢通讯结束。

source: &1014 Businesslike as ever. Let's go see what this is about.
target: &1014 还是一如既往地公事公办。去看看怎么回事吧。

source: &1380 Traveller - Begin Recording.
target: &1380 旅人——开始录音。

source: &1381 Lao, if you're listening to this...
target: &1381 劳，如果你听到了这段录音……

source: &1382 Well, it means they've caught me.
target: &1382 那就说明，他们已经抓到我了。

source: &1383 It wouldn't be right if I couldn't explain things to you, though.
target: &1383 但要是不把事情向你解释清楚，我实在过意不去。
